text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.
reply_text:
I sent you the list in our DM. I read all of #central-team, and it names two Marrow Agrisupply sites, plus one that might be Marrow:

1. Eastbank: from Hollis's message on Jun 9, 2026. Ticket PD-4821 has Eastbank's receiving-door import attached. The file calls the doors E1/E2, but their booking sheet uses 01/02. That needs fixing before anyone reimports, or it'll create duplicate doors.
2. Pine Crossing: from your message on Jun 9, 2026. The morning receiver only sees the afternoon shift on the appointment screen, so a 7:10 driver got written on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce it with the store login.
3. Wichita (not confirmed): from your message on Jul 2, 2025, about an 8am check-in with "the Wichita store dispatcher." It came up because your Zoom room was hosting the recurring Marrow Agrisupply office hours. Nothing there actually says Wichita is a Marrow store, so please check before you use it.

I left out the Tulsa hub from that same July 2025 conversation because it belongs to Tansley Parcel, not Marrow. Hollis also mentioned that three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker just say "waiting," but the channel never names those stores, so I can't tell you which ones they are.
